image_attribution_label.description: Accessible label for the button opening image source details.

image_attribution_source.description: Title of the image attribution source sheet.

show_sensitive_image.description: Accessible label for the button that removes the blur from a sensitive image preview.

speech_synthesizer_error.defaultMessage: Zvoka ni bilo mogoče predvajati. Poskusite znova.
speech_synthesizer_error.description: Neutral retryable speech playback error without technical detail or source text.

speech_synthesizer_loading.description: Polite live status while audio is loading. Stop remains available to cancel.

speech_synthesizer_play.description: Button to hear supplied text, including text hidden for a listening exercise; also retries after an error.

speech_synthesizer_stop.description: Button to stop speech playback or cancel pending synthesis. Playback cannot be paused or resumed.

speech_synthesizer_unavailable.description: Status when the current host cannot provide speech audio. Describes support or readiness, not authentication.

svg_illustration.description: Screen reader label for an illustration with no authored accessible name, title, or description.
